name: Howest University of Applied Sciences
summary: University of applied sciences in Kortrijk and Bruges; five English-taught bachelor's, from games and AI to cybersecurity and product design.

ib.text: A diploma giving access to university at home, B2 English and a motivation letter. The IB counts for English if taught in English, or with English A/B HL at 5 or English B SL at 6. €50 fee.

programmes.name: Digital Arts and Entertainment
programmes.ib: Choose a major at the start: game development, independent game production, game graphics, game sound, 3D animation or VFX. No portfolio needed.

notes: Applications for an autumn start open on 1 January; for 2026-27 the EEA deadline was 1 July, and 2027 dates are not yet published.
Howest may stop taking applications for some programmes once a limit from one country is reached, so it advises applying early.
Degree students can start only in September, not in the spring semester.
